Give the Fire Opal Activation Crystal to the Linvak Fetterguard's Weapons Golem that stands in the Linvak Armory. The Crystal can be found in the Trove of the Imperator in the Ossuary.

Find one of the Emblem recipe scrolls that were scattered into the many chests across the lands of Linvak Massif for safekeeping. Bring the scroll of your choice to the ghost of the Fetterguard. She will teach you the recipe, but choose wisely - she only has the strength to teach you one.

Hunt for Ebon Pyreal deposits that the spring thaws have exposed across Linvak Massif. The Gurog are also on the prowl for this precious metal and could be relieved of their stores. Use the Ebon Pyreal you've gathered in your Emblem quest recipe to create a Soulbound Weapon Emblem.
Give your Emblem to the Linvak Fetterguard Weapons Golem.

Spring thaw has exposed White Pyreal deposits in the Farali Wastes and Veseyan Isles. Hunt for this precious metal on the Burun and Erobal of these regions. Use the White Pyreal in your Emblem quest recipe to create a Soulbound Weapon Emblem.
Give your newly-crafted Omishan Emblem to the Omishan Weapons Golem to receive your Soulbound Weapon.
